skills.name: Prompt Chaining
skills.when_to_use: Chain focused prompts when each stage feeds the next.
skills.when_not_to_use: Skip for independent or single-prompt tasks.

skills.name: Routing
skills.when_to_use: Classify a request, then dispatch to one matching handler.
skills.when_not_to_use: Skip when every request takes the same path.
inputs: Set of named handlers with descriptions

skills.name: Parallelization
skills.when_to_use: Run independent branches concurrently, then merge.
skills.when_not_to_use: Skip when steps depend on each other.

skills.name: Reflection
skills.when_to_use: Critique a draft and refine it until criteria pass.
skills.when_not_to_use: Skip for cheap outputs with no criteria.

skills.name: Tool Use
skills.when_to_use: Call described functions for live data, compute or actions.
skills.when_not_to_use: Skip when model knowledge suffices or the action is unconfirmed.
outputs: Tool result fed back to model

skills.name: Planning
skills.when_to_use: Decompose a goal into ordered steps before acting.
skills.when_not_to_use: Skip for single actions or fixed pipelines.

skills.name: Multi-Agent Collaboration
skills.when_to_use: Split work across specialist agents with a coordination model.
skills.when_not_to_use: Skip when one agent with tools suffices.

skills.name: Memory Management
skills.when_to_use: Keep session state plus searchable long-term memory.
skills.when_not_to_use: Skip for stateless one-shot requests.

skills.name: Learning and Adaptation
skills.when_to_use: Update behaviour from evaluated outcomes over episodes.
skills.when_not_to_use: Skip when behaviour must stay fixed or no evaluator exists.

skills.name: Model Context Protocol
skills.when_to_use: Discover tools via an MCP server instead of hard-coding.
skills.when_not_to_use: Skip for a few local functions.
outputs: Discovered tool set on the agent

skills.name: Goal Setting and Monitoring
skills.when_to_use: Define measurable goals and loop until a judge says met.
skills.when_not_to_use: Skip when success is undefinable.

skills.name: Exception Handling and Recovery
skills.when_to_use: Detect failures, retry transient ones, fall back, escalate.
skills.when_not_to_use: Skip retries for deterministic errors.

skills.name: Human-in-the-Loop
skills.when_to_use: Escalate or confirm with a human at high-stakes points.
skills.when_not_to_use: Skip for high-volume routine decisions.

skills.name: Knowledge Retrieval (RAG)
skills.when_to_use: Retrieve top-k chunks and ground the answer in them.
skills.when_not_to_use: Skip when the corpus fits in context or is general knowledge.

skills.name: Inter-Agent Communication (A2A)
skills.when_to_use: Delegate tasks to remote agents via Agent Cards over HTTP.
skills.when_not_to_use: Skip for agents in the same process.

skills.name: Resource-Aware Optimization
skills.when_to_use: Classify complexity, route to the cheapest adequate model.
skills.when_not_to_use: Skip when one model meets budget and quality.

skills.name: Reasoning Techniques
skills.when_to_use: Make reasoning explicit with CoT, ToT, ReAct or self-correction.
skills.when_not_to_use: Skip for lookups and formatting.

skills.name: Guardrails / Safety Patterns
skills.when_to_use: Screen inputs, tool args and outputs against policy.
skills.when_not_to_use: Never rely on a single layer or self-policing.

skills.name: Evaluation and Monitoring
skills.when_to_use: Measure accuracy, latency, tokens, trajectory; judge with rubrics.
skills.when_not_to_use: Skip exact-match scoring for open-ended outputs.

skills.name: Prioritization
skills.when_to_use: Rank competing tasks by urgency, importance, deps, cost.
skills.when_not_to_use: Skip for one task or dependency-fixed order.

skills.name: Exploration and Discovery
skills.when_to_use: Generate, review, rank and evolve hypotheses in open domains.
skills.when_not_to_use: Skip for well-defined optimisation.
